earnings.title: media-relations@its.jnj.com
highlights: 2026 Third-Quarter earnings per share (EPS) of $0.09 reflects a one-time special charge for the proposed talc litigation resolution, the acquisition of Firefly Bio, Inc., and the strategic collaboration with Sail Biomedicines; adjusted EPS* of $2.59 also reflects the impact of these M&A deals
2026 Third-Quarter reported sales growth of 5.9% to $25.4 Billion with operational growth of 6.0%* and adjusted operational growth of 6.1%*

quotes.text: Johnson & Johnson’s strong third-quarter performance and increased sequential growth reflect the accelerating momentum of our focused portfolio.
quotes.by: Joaquin Duato, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer

outlook: Strong operational performance results in the Company increasing 2026 guidance with estimated reported sales of $101.2 Billion or 7.4% at the midpoint and increasing adjusted EPS* guidance by $0.06 to $11.10 or 2.9% at the midpoint

items.heading: Counterfeit versions of our products could harm our patients and have a negative impact on our revenues, earnings, reputation and business.
